bank: SubSDJ · improvement demos — v38 (in English since 1.4.0; + Notes by degree; Global swing; Sequencer articulations: accent, tie, slide, repeats; Runaway delay: feedback up to 110 % and loop saturation; String: Karplus-Strong with brightness, position and stiffness; Hard sync: A's pitch as timbre; Macros: one preset knob, several matrix destinations; Steps; Mod env; LFO in tempo, 2026-10)
note: Evidence bank: every engine improvement comes in here as an A/B pair — IDENTICAL presets except for the new parameter, so you can hear exactly what it adds. The numbered prefixes keep each pair next to each other. This bank GROWS with every new block of improvements. Load it with File ▾ → Import (it goes into «Imported»). The Seq presets need you to HOLD a key (it is the root that transposes the phrase). The WS presets shine with a held CHORD (each voice offsets its phrase). Trig: play LEGATO (the second key before releasing the first) — in Legato the note slides, in Retrig it retriggers. MIX: 1/2 = the ring no longer eats A; 3/4 = with Drive, raising the mixer saturates harder (the Minimoog trick). FMV: with a MIDI keyboard, soft and hard; at velocity 1 they sound the same (the probe renders them at 0.4, see «velocity»).
